domains.label: Sales by city and store
domains.owner_how: who pulls Posist Insights daily sales
domains.notes: Daily store sales start 4 Sep 2026. October is a full calendar month. November is through 12 Nov. Chattarpur and GK1 Cloud Kitchen are out of the sales base; Faridabad is out from 23 Oct. Manisquare and Forum sales are counted; bills and APB stay out of comparisons.

domains.label: Sales by channel (Swiggy, Zomato, and others)
domains.owner_how: who pulls Posist Insights channel sales
domains.notes: Store-level channel files cover 2–15 Oct and 1–12 Nov 2026, except 1 Oct and 9 Nov, which are not on disk and are left out (not treated as zero). 16–31 Oct are network-wide totals only (ALL (network) / ALL DEPLOYMENTS), not store-level. A 9 Sep–8 Oct 30-day range file is in data/posist; it is not a calendar month. Calendar September is not loaded.

domains.label: Procurement purchases and ingredient prices
domains.notes: Purchases and item prices run from 1 Apr 2026. April–August are calendar-month Entry Reports and Purchase Summaries (days with no GRN are days with no invoice, left out not treated as zero). September purchases combine the 1–8 Sep backfill with GRN lines for 9–30 Sep; Delhi has no 1 Sep or 6 Sep entry in the 1–8 pack. October purchases are GRN 1–8 Oct only. Item prices: Apr–Aug from the official Purchase Summary; Sep is a qty-weighted average of 1–8 Sep entries plus 9–30 Sep GRN; October is complete and November is 1–12, from procurement_summary.json. Freight and other invoice charges are kept separate from item totals. The Purchase Summary .xls files are HTML.

domains.label: Menu mix by month
domains.owner_how: who pulls the Posist menu-mix extracts
domains.notes: Calendar September and October are loaded. A 14 Oct–12 Nov Friday file is also in data/menu; it is a 30-day window, not a calendar month. November calendar month is not complete. April–August are not loaded.

domains.label: Reelo monthly customers, orders and spend
domains.owner_how: who pulls the Reelo dashboard exports
domains.notes: Monthly customers, orders and average spend for April–October 2026. November is 1–12 only. Campaign metrics are mostly blank.

domains.label: Swiggy and Zomato aggregator performance
domains.owner_how: who maintains the brand aggregator workbook
domains.notes: August–October 2026 from Sanjoy's 13 Nov workbook, 26 outlets. Faridabad Sector 15 (DC-09) is left out. Outlet names are mapped only where the store master or the same DC key is clear; unmapped names stay as in the workbook. Zomato actuals are complete. Swiggy impressions, ads and refunds are blank (still pending).

domains.label: Grand Economics (P&L)
domains.owner_how: who sends the Grand Economics workbook
domains.notes: April–September 2026, both cities, city-level lines from grand_economics_tidy.csv. October and November 2026 are not in the file. Owner and finance only.

domains.label: Tally day book
domains.owner_how: who sends the daily Tally Day Book packs (via Shilajit)
domains.notes: Vouchers from 30 Sep through 11 Nov 2026, with gaps. 16–27 Oct and 6, 8, 9, 11 Nov were parsed from raw packs on the box for this PR. 7 and 10 Nov are not in the pack. April–29 Sep are not loaded. Missing days are left out, not filled with zero. Owner and finance only.

domains.label: HR monthly joiners and exits (counts only)
domains.notes: April–November 2026 location-level joiner and exit counts. November is 1–12 only. No employee names. Owner only.

domains.label: Famepilot ticket counts
domains.owner_how: who pulls the Famepilot ticket export
domains.notes: Ticket counts by store and platform, 1 Sep–9 Oct 2026. Customer names are not stored. April–August and 10 Oct onward are not loaded.

rule: When a month is not loaded, say the data is not loaded yet and name who it would come from. Never estimate.
